newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Plywood firm Tai Fu seen in HK$200 mln IPO-sources.
newsitem.headline: Plywood firm Tai Fu seen in HK$200 mln IPO-sources.

text.p: Taiwan-based plywood manufacturer Tai Fu International Holdings Ltd is expected to raise about HK$200 million by issuing 168 million shares in an initial public offer (IPO) in Hong Kong, market sources said.
The shares are expected to be issued at a price ranging from HK$1.1 to HK$1.2 per share, representing a prospective price to earnings multiple of six to eight times, they said.
Proceeds raised from the issue are expected to be used to expand its manufacturing facilities in China, sources said.
The IPO is expected to run from December 11 to 16 and dealing in the company's shares is expected to begin on December 23, they said.

Tai Fu posted profit US$7.5 million for the year ended December 31, 1995, up from US$4.0 million in 1994 and US$4.4 million in 1993. Turnover rose to US$120 million in 1995, from US$90 million in 1994 and US$90 million in 1993, they said.
The plywood manufacturer posted profit of US$3.7 million on a turnover of US$80 million for the first seven months of 1996, sources said.
BZW and OCBC are expected to be the sponsors of the issue, they said.
